## CONTRIBUTION GUIDELINES - DELETE THIS SECTION BEFORE SUBMITTING

Apply Team will review every PR that is submitted. Please make sure you mark any PR as a [DRAFT] while you're working
on it to prevent it being reviewed in an incomplete state! If you would like early feedback on a draft pull request please explicitly ask in [our team channel](https://fundingcircle.slack.com/archives/C03P1AFREN5)

We aim to review every within 48 hours. If you haven't heard back from us, please feel free to ping us
on [Slack](https://fundingcircle.slack.com/archives/C03P1AFREN5)!

For more info,
read [the guide to writing awesome Pull Requests](https://confluence.fundingcircle.com/display/ProdEng/Pull+Requests).
